star_rules.win: Before every star duel the hero picks a wager from 1 to min(his stars, the rival's stars). A win takes that many stars from the rival.
star_rules.lose: The rival keeps the wagered stars (his count grows). A beaten rival who still holds stars won from the hero (more than his count after a minimum loss) offers a rematch wager to win them back.
star_rules.zero_stars: GAME OVER: losing the last star ends the journey (game-over screen, back to the title, Continue loads the last save; nothing is saved at zero stars). Shadi, Pegasus's mirror, the Shore Camp sign and the trail camp staff warn about it.
star_rules.each_duelist_once: Every named star duelist holds a fixed number of stars (Weevil 2, Rex 2, Forest Mage 3, Bandit Keith 3, Mountain Mage 4). The story win happens once; later rematches only win back stars he took from the hero.
star_rules.wager: A star duel opens the wager picker after the pre-duel ask (left/right to change the bet, X to duel, S to back out).
star_rules.star_budget: Betting the minimum (1) on every story duel gives the curve: ch1 Shadi 1, ch2 Weevil 2, ch3 Rex 3 and Forest Mage 4, ch4 Bandit Keith 5 and Mountain Mage 6, then one per gate up to 10. Bigger bets can jump ahead (or end the journey). Area gates count only stars in hand; the Castle Gate opens only with 10.

variables.duel_held: per star duelist, the stars he holds now (save, slot by duel order)
variables.kflags: second 31-bit flag word used from stage 10 on (home-town flags are frozen)

star_rules.hud: A star icon with the number next to the objective line.

areas.setting: Sandy beach, a pier, tents of duelists, a sign 'Welcome, bugs and champions'.
Dense forest, star-shaped cuts on tree trunks, a hidden clearing.
Rocky pass, a gambler's tent, a cliff overlook.
Hedge maze in a flowery meadow.
Dunes, a fortune teller's tent, a half-buried stone star.
Festival plaza at the island's center: stalls, banners, a duel ring. Hub.
Huge gate with a star-shaped lock that counts stars.
Illusion-filled halls: shifting stairs, portraits that wink.
Pegasus's top room: cards pinned like butterflies, a big window to the sea.

chapters.summary_en: Landing. A recorded Pegasus welcomes everyone through a mirror. Weevil ambushes the rookie with loaded dice: the first wagered duel. First lesson: stars are real, the Shore Camp is the safety net.
chapters.summary_pt: Desembarque. Um Pegasus gravado da boas-vindas por um espelho. Weevil embosca o novato com dados viciados: o primeiro duelo com aposta. Primeira licao: estrelas sao reais, o Acampamento da Costa e a rede de seguranca.
chapters.beat: Pegasus's mirror hello. 'The Hooded Man' reappears for one line: Shadi watches from the pier.

chapters.summary_en: Star-shaped cuts mark the trees. Follow three Star Marks to open the hidden clearing. Rex Raptor is lost in the forest and furious about it.
chapters.summary_pt: Cortes em forma de estrela marcam as arvores. Siga tres Marcas de Estrela para abrir a clareira. Rex Raptor esta perdido na floresta e furioso.
chapters.beat: Mystery: who carves the stars? (Answered in chapter 4: Croquet, so Pegasus can watch the route.)

chapters.summary_en: Bandit Keith charges a one-star toll at the rope bridge. Mai blocks the cliff path for a proper rival duel. The Mountain Mage guards the summit.
chapters.summary_pt: Bandit Keith cobra um pedagio de uma estrela na ponte de corda. Mai bloqueia o penhasco para um duelo de rivais. O Mago da Montanha guarda o topo.
chapters.beat: Mai warms up to the hero after the duel. The star-carver is Croquet.

chapters.summary_en: A hedge maze. The giggling barrel from the ship was Teana: she stowed away! She joins as a helper who gives hints, after a friendly duel. The Meadow Mage hides in the center.
chapters.summary_pt: Um labirinto de cercas vivas. O barril que ria no navio era a Teana: ela fugiu escondida! Ela vira ajudante que da dicas, depois de um duelo amistoso. A Maga da Campina fica no centro.
chapters.beat: Pay-off of the barrel gag; Teana carries her golden star from the hooded man: it matches the Kingdom's star shape.

chapters.summary_en: A fortune teller reads the hero's cards and drops a clue: someone upstairs collects stars of eliminated duelists. Bakura floats in, bored of the cistern, and challenges the hero for fun.
chapters.summary_pt: Uma cartomante le as cartas do heroi e solta uma pista: alguem la em cima junta as estrelas dos eliminados. Bakura aparece flutuando, entediado da cisterna, e desafia o heroi por diversao.
chapters.beat: Clue: the star collector. Bakura callback to the home cistern. MAGO.DEV glimpse 5: Isis senses a watcher in the cards.

chapters.summary_en: Midpoint hub: festival, shops that sell cards for star chips earned in practice duels, ring duels. Jono arrives on his raft, soaked, and duels as a friendly rival. InsetoKaiba lands by dragonfly-shaped helicopter and swears he will take the hero's stars.
chapters.summary_pt: Hub do meio: festival, lojas, duelos no ringue. Jono chega na sua jangada, encharcado, e duela como rival amigo. InsetoKaiba pousa num helicoptero em forma de libelula e jura tomar as estrelas do heroi.
chapters.beat: Heishin's agents are seen herding eliminated duelists to the castle cellars. MAGO.DEV glimpse 6: still silhouette in the crowd, first (hidden) line.

chapters.summary_en: The gate counts stars: 10 needed. The gate guardian is InsetoKaiba, rematch of the ship: bigger deck, bigger ego, same bugs (Great Moth and Javelin Beetle). Reward: the Crown Beetle card and the gate key.
chapters.summary_pt: O portao conta estrelas: sao necessarias 10. O guardiao e InsetoKaiba, revanche do navio: baralho maior, ego maior, mesmos insetos (Great Moth e Javelin Beetle). Premio: a carta Crown Beetle e a chave do portao.
chapters.beat: He loses, then declares the hero 'a worthy bug' and holds the gate open, grumbling. The lock counts exactly 10.

chapters.summary_en: Illusion halls. Chamberlain Heishin was harvesting lost stars for a 'Star Crown' to rule the island. Beat him, free the eliminated duelists' stars, and they go home happy.
chapters.summary_pt: Salas de ilusao. O Camareiro Heishin juntava estrelas perdidas para uma 'Coroa Estelar' que governaria a ilha. Venca-o, liberte as estrelas dos eliminados e eles voltam felizes.
chapters.beat: Twist: Pegasus knew and wanted to see whether a rookie would stop it. MAGO.DEV glimpse 7: mirror, he could delete Heishin and does not.

chapters.summary_en: Final duel with Pegasus, who plays with 'hidden-hand' flavor. Win: choose a wish (a Dream Card, return everyone's stars, or a Festival for everyone). Canon wish: a festival. Epilogue: the home-town painted village on festival day with every rival as a sprite. Simon's message is delivered: 'you still owe me a card'.
chapters.summary_pt: Duelo final com Pegasus, com sabor de 'mao escondida'. Vencer: escolha um desejo (uma Carta dos Sonhos, devolver as estrelas de todos, ou um Festival para todos). Desejo canonico: um festival. Epilogo: a vila pintada em dia de festa com todos os rivais como sprites. A mensagem do Simon e entregue: 'voce ainda me deve uma carta'.

duelists.name: Pegasus
duelists.role: final boss (needs a tier 9 deck; base deck is tier 6)

chapters.beat: Shadi's last cameo. Ending 'festival': everyone visits the village. MAGO.DEV payoff on the plaza bench: the hero finally notices him.

mago_dev.rules: Mago.dev programs reality, but never interferes: he never fights, trades, opens doors, gives items or solves anything. He is seen as a robed silhouette in a green aura, or only as green glitch writing. He speaks only three times in the whole story.

appearances.note: Isis senses him in the cards. No sprite.

pages_en.speaker: isis
pages_en.text: The cards show a watcher. Not from this island. Not from this world.

pages_en.speaker: isis
pages_en.text: He writes reality, yet today he only reads. Do not seek him.

pages_pt.speaker: isis
pages_pt.text: As cartas mostram um observador. Nao e desta ilha. Nao e deste mundo.

pages_pt.speaker: isis
pages_pt.text: Ele escreve a realidade, mas hoje so le. Nao o procure.

appearances.note: Silhouette in the crowd at the Star Fair ring during the Jono duel. First line, still hidden as '???'.

pages_en.speaker: narrator
pages_en.text: In the crowd, one figure stands perfectly still in a green shimmer.
pages_en.label: Crowd

pages_en.speaker: mago_hidden
pages_en.text: Take your time. I have all of it.

pages_en.speaker: narrator
pages_en.text: A glitch, and the spot is empty.
pages_en.label: Crowd

pages_pt.speaker: narrator
pages_pt.text: Na multidao, uma figura fica perfeitamente parada num brilho verde.
pages_pt.label: Multidao

pages_pt.speaker: mago_hidden
pages_pt.text: Leve o tempo que precisar. Eu tenho todo ele.

pages_pt.speaker: narrator
pages_pt.text: Um glitch, e o lugar esta vazio.
pages_pt.label: Multidao

appearances.note: In a hall mirror, behind the hero's reflection, while Heishin's star harvest is exposed. He could end it with one line of code, and does not.

pages_en.speaker: narrator
pages_en.text: In the hall mirror, behind your reflection, a robed figure in green light watches Heishin.
pages_en.label: Mirror

pages_en.speaker: mago_hidden
pages_en.text: I could delete him. I won't. It is your duel.

pages_en.speaker: narrator
pages_en.text: The mirror shows only you again.
pages_en.label: Mirror

pages_pt.speaker: narrator
pages_pt.text: No espelho do salao, atras do seu reflexo, uma figura de manto em luz verde observa Heishin.
pages_pt.label: Espelho

pages_pt.speaker: mago_hidden
pages_pt.text: Eu poderia apaga-lo. Nao vou. E o seu duelo.

pages_pt.speaker: narrator
pages_pt.text: O espelho mostra so voce de novo.
pages_pt.label: Espelho

payoff.when: Epilogue, festival day in the painted village, after the Pegasus wish. He sits on the old bench in the plain tee (robe off). First time he is talkable.

pages_en.speaker: narrator
pages_en.text: Festival day. Every rival fills the plaza. On the old bench sits a boy in a tee.
pages_en.label: Festival Day

pages_en.speaker: atos
pages_en.text: You were on the roof. In the cistern. On the mast. It was you.

pages_en.speaker: narrator
pages_en.text: Green letters flicker above his head. They read Mago.dev.
pages_en.label: Name

pages_en.speaker: atos
pages_en.text: You could have helped me. Many times.

pages_en.speaker: mago_dev_tee
pages_en.text: You did not need me. Good game.

pages_en.speaker: narrator
pages_en.text: A soft green flicker, and the bench is empty. The palms sway a little faster.
pages_en.label: Glitch

pages_pt.speaker: narrator
pages_pt.text: Dia de festa. Todos os rivais lotam a praca. No velho banco senta um rapaz de camiseta.
pages_pt.label: Dia de Festa

pages_pt.speaker: atos
pages_pt.text: Voce estava no telhado. Na cisterna. No mastro. Era voce.

pages_pt.speaker: narrator
pages_pt.text: Letras verdes piscam sobre a cabeca dele. Dizem Mago.dev.
pages_pt.label: Nome

pages_pt.speaker: atos
pages_pt.text: Voce poderia ter me ajudado. Muitas vezes.

pages_pt.speaker: mago_dev_tee
pages_pt.text: Voce nao precisou de mim. Bom jogo.

pages_pt.speaker: narrator
pages_pt.text: Um leve piscar verde, e o banco esta vazio. As palmeiras balancam um pouco mais rapido.
pages_pt.label: Glitch
